name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA, capturing the deal-specific terms: purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law and jurisdiction, modifications, and party details for signature.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA that lets both parties share confidential information for a stated purpose, covering use and protection obligations, exceptions, required disclosures, term and return of information.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, restrictions, fees and payment, data, warranties, liability limits, indemnification, and term and termination.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Uptime and support commitments that supplement a cloud service agreement, including target uptime, target response times, how each is calculated, and service credits as the remedy for missed targets.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a product agreement that governs AI services, covering use of AI services, restrictions, model training on customer input, ownership of input and output, personal data and AI-specific disclaimers.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms governing how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer as processor or subprocessor, including security measures, subprocessors, data subject requests, breach notification and international transfers.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity customer.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, intellectual property, warranties and liability.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs on its own systems, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties and liability.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for an early-stage design partner program, giving a partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in the program.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Terms for a limited-time pilot or trial of a product so the customer can evaluate it before committing to a full purchase.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement for a business partnership in which each party performs agreed obligations, covering cooperation, payments, trademark use, confidentiality and liability.
